card.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
card.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called my audition interesting. What came after that in your head?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my sister. I'm trying to be encouraging.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the encouraging half and the half you swallowed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your singing was better than your dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better by how much? Are we buying dance lessons or shoes that don't move?

mechanism: A treats polite audition feedback as incomplete and presses for the withheld critical comparison.
confusable: Unlike simply requesting praise, A must read care in the answer as a sign of omitted content.
comparison: D102-a asks how much worse the dancing was; D102-b asks who replaces A in a carefully edited proposal account.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
